A '''[[Senator/Legends|Senator]]''' represented the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Orron III]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] in the year [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]]. He was a member of the [[Ministry of Defense]], and in 4000 BBY he attended a meeting headed by [[Minister of Defense (Republic)|Minister of Defense]] [[Netus]] to discuss what course of action to be taken regarding the [[Freedon Nadd Uprising]] on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]].
